OurPurpose.paragraph1: We are a network of healthcare professionals called and entrusted by God (Elohim) with a spiritual purpose. Grounded in Romans 8:29–30, we understand the practice of medicine as more than a profession—it is a sacred vocation to serve our neighbor with humility, compassion, and excellence.
OurPurpose.paragraph2: We recognize that God has endowed us with intelligence, discipline, and capacity for innovation. We promote critical thinking and scientific development as tools to achieve excellence in comprehensive clinical care, advance modern medical knowledge, and develop ethical and responsible solutions that respond to the real needs of every community.
OurPurpose.paragraph3: Our commitment: to integrate faith, science, and service to restore dignity, promote healing, and generate lasting well-being. We offer ethical, evidence-based, high-impact medical solutions, focused on the following areas:
OurPurpose.commitmentText: In all that we do, we are committed to upholding the highest standards of scientific rigor, ethical responsibility, and compassionate service. Through the integration of faith, medicine, education, research, and community engagement, we aim to contribute to a healthcare system that not only treats illness but also restores hope, preserves dignity, and promotes the long-term well-being of individuals and communities.

WhoWeAre.heroDesc: International Kingdom Medical Association, IKMA, is a company of Kingdom-minded apostolic health professionals who are deeply committed to integrating God's Kingdom pattern in our medical practice, seeking to bring God's ordained solutions to the pressing health challenges of our time, thus bringing healing to the nations.
WhoWeAre.heroBelief: We believe in a holistic approach to healing and well-being of the mind, body, and spirit — rooted in biblical principles and compassionate care.
WhoWeAre.founderSpeech_p1: Today, our world faces a range of challenges—both physical and spiritual—that have persisted across generations, as well as new ones that continue to emerge. These include infectious diseases, war, famine, and the everyday struggles of life that impact human well-being.
WhoWeAre.founderSpeech_p2: While the healthcare system exists to support and maintain health, it often presents additional difficulties. Many people encounter barriers such as the high cost of medication, complicated insurance systems, limited access to care in rural areas, and, at times, treatments that do not fully address the root cause of illness. Too often, the focus remains on managing symptoms rather than pursuing true healing by identifying and removing the underlying causes of disease—a task that is complex, but deeply necessary.
WhoWeAre.founderSpeech_p3: As awareness of health grows, people are seeking answers and solutions now more than ever. Unfortunately, this has also led to the rise of false healers and misleading medical claims—offering empty promises that create dependency and disappointment rather than genuine freedom and restoration.
WhoWeAre.founderSpeech_p4: We believe that humanity—and the nations of the world—are currently living below the full potential that God has given us. Our mission is to take part in rebuilding, restoring, and renewing the field of medicine so that it fulfills its true purpose: to preserve life and support the flourishing of all people. As it is written in Isaiah 61:4–7, we are called to rebuild what has been broken and restore what has been lost.
WhoWeAre.founderSpeech_p5: We are part of a people who seek to restore humanity to its original design as created by Elohim. We believe in the strength that comes from unity, and in the truth that "we can do all things through Christ who strengthens us" (Philippians 4:13). Together, under God, we stand in faith and purpose, committed to bringing healing, restoration, and lasting transformation to the world.
WhoWeAre.partnerDescription: We are a network of healthcare professionals grounded in the biblical principles of the Kingdom of God, sent to the healthcare field to establish God's model on earth.
WhoWeAre.partnerDescription2: We seek to integrate the highest medical standards from three continents with humanitarian and community outreach initiatives internationally.

OurObjectives.heroDesc: 10 strategic pillars of impact to guide our mission of restoring health, strengthening families, transforming communities, and advancing God's Kingdom among the nations.
OurObjectives.pillarOneItems_0: Promote access to care for safe, effective, affordable, and quality health services, regardless of socioeconomic status.
OurObjectives.pillarOneItems_1: Empower communities by fostering practices that maintain mental, physical, and spiritual health in alignment with biblical principles.
OurObjectives.pillarOneItems_2: Foster cooperations through regional, national and international partnership.
OurObjectives.quote: “We are called to rebuild what has been broken and restore what has been lost.”
OurObjectives.quoteAttribution: — Apostle John Boney, founder of IKMA
OurObjectives.pillarTwoItems_0: Establish an academy to train health professionals and students in both biblical and secular medicine topics, bridging the gap between faith and practice, impacting men and women in the health field to be transformed and establish the government of the Kingdom of God in health care facilities of the nations.
OurObjectives.pillarTwoItems_1: Shape a generation of “health warriors” in their training process, preparing them for holistic health ministry.
OurObjectives.pillarTwoItems_2: Establish support system for low-income undergraduate and graduate students, providing grant and scholarship and nurturing environment for their academical success and spiritual growth.
OurObjectives.pillarThreeTitle: Bringing Kingdom solutions to the Nations
OurObjectives.pillarThreeItems_0: Build specialized outpatient clinics staffed by kingdom-minded healthcare professionals, offering high quality solutions to diverse health issues with compassion and spiritual insight.
OurObjectives.pillarThreeItems_1: Conduct medical campaigns by combining essential (social) outreach and evangelism, demonstrating God’s love through action.
OurObjectives.pillarThreeItems_2: Organize and empower regional committees in partner countries.
OurObjectives.pillarThreeItems_3: Realize research for groundbreaking medical discoveries as led by the Holy Spirit.

Outreach.heroTitle: Care for underserved populations and health outreach
Outreach.paragraph1: Our community deployments and healthcare initiatives in Venezuela go far beyond conventional medical assistance. We firmly believe in a holistic care approach, where physical health, emotional well-being, and the spiritual dimension intertwine to completely transform lives.
Outreach.paragraph2: By mobilizing multidisciplinary teams—comprising general practitioners, specialists, therapists, and dedicated volunteers—we move directly into the heart of the communities that need it most. Each outreach event is a living manifestation of compassion and service, designed not only to heal bodies but also to plant faith, restore hope, and strengthen the family fabric in every corner we visit.
Outreach.chronicleIntro: Below, we share the chronicles of our most recent interventions—testimonies of an unwavering commitment to the well-being of our people.
Outreach.quote: “Beyond numbers and diagnoses, the true success of our mission is measured in the stories of transformation, the restored smiles, and the lives deeply impacted in every consultation.”

OutreachCommunities.title: Rural communities in Venezuela are served by IKMA doctors
OutreachCommunities.paragraph1: The deployment of our doctors in the communities of Venezuela has become one of the most powerful and positive experiences for our organization.
OutreachCommunities.paragraph2: This is not just a multidisciplinary deployment of healthcare professionals from different specialties (dentistry, physical therapy, general medicine, pediatrics...); it is the living manifestation of God’s love through each healthcare professional.
OutreachCommunities.paragraph3: Beyond the numbers, the true result is measured in lives. Men, women, children, and adolescents have been completely transformed in every consultation.
OutreachCommunities.paragraph4: The most moving part was that children who had not experienced the relief of a pediatric consultation for over 8 years were finally seen by doctors filled with the love of God.
OutreachCommunities.paragraph5: In this mission, free healthcare was the bridge to connect with them, but the quality and kindness of the medical consultations were what impacted the community the most.
OutreachCommunities.paragraph6: While patients received treatment, they also found refuge amid uncertainty—joy born from feeling valued by healthcare professionals who have surrendered their lives to Jesus Christ.
OutreachCommunities.paragraph7: We bring science with spirit because when professional knowledge meets faith, service becomes a miracle.

Membership.step1Desc:
IKMA membership is open to licensed health professionals, residents, students in health-related careers, and enthusiasts from other fields who share the vision of promoting health and integral healing with integrity.

When you join, you become part of a global and diverse community of colleagues committed to serving the Kingdom of God through medicine and related fields. You will have the opportunity to connect with leaders and innovators in global health, nutrition, socio-medical issues, regenerative medicine, and more.

Through strategic discussions, collaboration, and continuous learning, you will exchange knowledge with professionals from around the world. Together we will receive the inspiration and tools needed to become agents of positive change, bringing healing and restoration according to divine purpose.

Membership requires an accessible annual fee that helps sustain our programs and resources, guaranteeing you access to a vibrant international network adapted to your region.

OutreachZumurucuare.title: Statistical balance of medical and spiritual intervention – Zumurucuare, Falcón
OutreachZumurucuare.paragraph1: In the Zumurucuare sector, in Falcón state, Venezuela, the International Kingdom Medical Association (IKMA) carried out a comprehensive medical mission that transcended conventional care. It was not just about listening to heartbeats, taking blood pressure, or handing out medications; it was the living manifestation of God’s compassion through this global project that unites scientific excellence with God’s transforming power.
OutreachZumurucuare.paragraph2: From the early hours of the morning, doctors, specialists, veterinarians, and health volunteers trained under IKMA’s vision turned this corner of Falcón into a true center of restoration and holistic service.
OutreachZumurucuare.paragraph3: At every consultation station, the residents of Zumurucuare found not only accurate diagnoses and care for their physical ailments; they also found a listening ear, dignity, hygiene, care for their pets, and above all, faith in every healthcare professional.
OutreachZumurucuare.paragraph4: Thanks to the dedication of the multidisciplinary team, a total of 222 direct consultations were recorded, distributed across the following specialties and interventions:
OutreachZumurucuare.stats:
Barber Shop (Community Service) 32
Nursing (Weight and Height Check) 37
Veterinary Care (Pets) 25
Pain Therapy 20
Pediatrics 20
Internal Medicine 15
Traumatology 14
Cardiology 13
Intercession and Spiritual Coverage 13
Gynecology 09
Psychology 08
Nephrology 03
Surgery 03
OutreachZumurucuare.paragraph5: What happened in this Venezuelan community is just a sample of what God is doing through IKMA’s global network on the three continents where we are located.
